say:4:1610601101:1.text: Gather round, everyone. The Lyceum has been unsettled lately. By now, you've heard the tragic news of Headmaster Leymar's passing.

say:9:1610601104:1.text: Quiet! This is not the time for questions!

say:11:1610601105:1.text: The headmaster's death is still under investigation. But the Lyceum cannot be left without leadership. Someone has to take charge of the daily affairs.

choice_prompt:14:1610601107.text: That is my first announcement. Any objections?

say:15:1610601108:1.source_cn: 很好，大家应该都没什么问题。

say:18:1610601111:0.text: Yes. Headmaster Leymar held a vital position. His death has caught the attention of the royal family and several mage factions.

say:19:1610601112:0.text: Last night, the royal court and the Academy Board formed a joint investigative team. A royal envoy has been dispatched to oversee the investigation personally.

say:20:1610601113:0.source_cn: 鉴于王室与学校的协议，这次审讯必须放在隶属于帝国管辖的...

say:21:1610601114:0.source_cn: 这次你们由我陪同，可以暂时离开校园，但不得私自行动。其...

choice:17:1:2.male: I thought we weren't allowed to leave the school.
choice:17:1:2.female: I thought we weren't allowed to leave the school.

say:22:1610601115:0.source_cn: 格墨文也会接受调查，但和你们不在同一个场所。贵族自有属...

say:23:1610601116:0.text: Gervan, please remain here. Someone will arrive shortly to escort you.
say:23:1610601116:0.source_cn: 格墨文，请你在这里稍候，会有人来为你带路的。

say:25:1610601117:0.text: Understood... But Madam Durella, if everyone else is being questioned elsewhere, it feels wrong for me to be treated differently.
say:25:1610601117:0.source_cn: 我知道了……可是，杜瑞拉女士，其他人都去治安审查所，我...

say:28:1610601119:0.text: I'm sorry, I had no idea this would happen.
say:28:1610601119:0.source_cn: ……各位同伴，很抱歉，我并不知道这一切。

say:29:1610601120:0.text: We should be facing this together. But my noble status keeps me from going with you all. I'm truly ashamed of that.

say:29:1610601120:0.female: We should be facing this together. But my noble status keeps me from going with you all. I'm truly ashamed of that.

say:31:1610601121:1.text: There's no need to apologize. It's not your fault.

say:34:1610601122:0.text: Don't worry about us. We didn't do anything wrong. As long as we tell the envoy what really happened, everything will be fine.
say:34:1610601122:0.source_cn: 别担心我们，我们并没有做什么错事，只要把当时的情景和特...
say:34:1610601122:0.male: Don't worry about us. We didn't do anything wrong. As long as we tell the envoy what really happened, everything will be fine.
say:34:1610601122:0.female: Don't worry about us. We didn't do anything wrong. As long as we tell the envoy what really happened, everything will be fine.

say:40:1610601124:1.text: The rest of you, follow me. We will begin interrogations one by one.
say:40:1610601124:1.source_cn: 其他人，立刻随我前往治安审查所接受审讯。

say:42:1610601125:0.text: Wh-why are we being interrogated? We didn't do anything!
say:42:1610601125:0.source_cn: 为什么……我们、我们什么也没做啊！为什么要审讯我们？而...

say:43:1610601126:0.text: Are they seriously treating us like suspects already?
say:43:1610601126:0.source_cn: 难道……难道那位特使已经认定我们是杀害校长的犯人了？！

say:44:1610601127:0.text: The headmaster's sudden death has made everyone present at the scene a suspect in the eyes of the envoy. But if you have nothing to hide, there's no need to be afraid.
say:44:1610601127:0.source_cn: 校长突然死亡，帝国特使认为在场的所有人都有嫌疑。但只要...

say:46:1610601128:0.source_cn: 校长身亡是我们莱希拉姆内部事件，为什么帝国特使要参与其中？

say:47:1610601129:1.text: That is not for you to concern yourself with. Everything I'm doing as acting headmistress is for the good of the school.
say:47:1610601129:1.source_cn: 这不是你们应该知道的，不要多问。身为代理校长，我这么做...

say:48:1610601130:1.text: That will be all for now. We must not keep the envoy waiting.
say:48:1610601130:1.source_cn: 好了，问答环节到此结束，我们不能让帝国特使大人等太久。
